exercises.name: 1. Jump Rope or March in Place
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raise. Stay relaxed and light on the feet.

exercises.name: 2a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as possible with soft landings. Full intent each rep.

exercises.name: 2b. Plyo Push-Up
exercises.notes: Hands leave floor slightly. If needed, elevate hands on a bench or couch.

exercises.name: 3. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use backpack, dumbbell, or kettlebell. Control down for 2 seconds, drive up hard. RPE 7.

exercises.name: 4. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Stop with 2 reps in reserve. Elevate hands if needed to keep form clean.

exercises.name: 5. 1-Arm Dumbbell or Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Pull elbow toward hip. Pause briefly at top. Use a weighted backpack if no dumbbell.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift with Dumbbells or Backpack
exercises.notes: Soft knees, hinge at hips, feel hamstrings. Keep back neutral. RPE 7.

exercises.name: 7a. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Hold a plate, backpack, or household item at chest. Smooth reps.

exercises.name: 7b. Towel Neck Flexion and Extension
exercises.notes: Gentle resistance only. Move slowly and stay pain-free.

exercises.name: 8. Zone 2 Shadowboxing or Brisk Walk
exercises.notes: Easy aerobic pace. Nasal breathing if possible. RPE 5–6.

exercises.name: 1. Jump Rope or March in Place
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raise. Stay relaxed and light on the feet.

exercises.name: 2a. Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Stick the landing. Reset between reps. Full effort.

exercises.name: 2b. Plyo Push-Up
exercises.notes: Explode up fast. Use incline if standard version is too hard.

exercises.name: 3. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Add a little load if all week 1 sets were solid. RPE 7–8.

exercises.name: 4. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Keep body straight. Add reps before adding load.

exercises.name: 5. 1-Arm Dumbbell or Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Use a controlled lowering phase of 2 seconds. RPE 8 on final set.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift with Dumbbells or Backpack
exercises.notes: Squeeze glutes at top. Do not turn it into a squat.

exercises.name: 7a. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Add a little load if all reps were clean last week.

exercises.name: 7b. Towel Neck Flexion and Extension
exercises.notes: Light, controlled, no jerking.

exercises.name: 8. Tempo Shadowboxing Intervals
exercises.notes: Moderate pace, crisp technique, not all-out. RPE 6–7.

exercises.name: 1. Jump Rope or March in Place
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raise. Stay relaxed and light on the feet.

exercises.name: 2a. Skater Jump
exercises.notes: Cover distance with control. Stick each landing.

exercises.name: 2b. Explosive Incline Push-Up or Plyo Push-Up
exercises.notes: Fast concentric. Choose the version that keeps speed high.

exercises.name: 3. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Slightly heavier than week 2 if possible. RPE 8.

exercises.name: 4. Push-Up with 1-Second Pause at Bottom
exercises.notes: Pause just off the floor, then drive up. Great for control and hypertrophy.

exercises.name: 5. 1-Arm Dumbbell or Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Heavier than previous weeks if available. Keep chest supported on bench or knee if needed.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift with Dumbbells or Backpack
exercises.notes: Heavier if possible. Maintain hinge mechanics.

exercises.name: 7a. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Challenging but smooth. No momentum.

exercises.name: 7b. Towel Neck Flexion and Extension
exercises.notes: Keep effort moderate and pain-free.

exercises.name: 8. Shadowboxing Power Intervals
exercises.notes: Fast hands and feet on work periods. Stay sharp, not sloppy. RPE 7–8.

exercises.name: 1. Jump Rope or March in Place
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raise. Stay relaxed and light on the feet.

exercises.name: 2a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Keep quality high. This is a lighter deload week.

exercises.name: 2b. Plyo Push-Up
exercises.notes: Explosive but low fatigue. Stop before speed drops.

exercises.name: 3. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use week 3 load or slightly lighter. RPE 6–7.

exercises.name: 4. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 3 reps in reserve. Smooth reps only.

exercises.name: 5. 1-Arm Dumbbell or Backpack Row
exercises.notes: Moderate load. Focus on full range and control.

exercises.name: 6. Romanian Deadlift with Dumbbells or Backpack
exercises.notes: Light-moderate effort. Good hinge mechanics.

exercises.name: 7a. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Moderate effort. Keep trunk braced.

exercises.name: 7b. Towel Neck Flexion and Extension
exercises.notes: Easy maintenance work only.

exercises.name: 8. Zone 2 Shadowboxing or Brisk Walk
exercises.notes: Easy aerobic pace. Finish fresh.
